messages:
lucy (Growth): Proposal: OSS Starter Kit + community benchmark + contribution playbook. Lightweight repo, reproducible bench, and a short launch post + HN seed.
omar (DevRel): +1. Keep repo tiny: Dockerfile, `run-bench.sh`, sample prompts, and a CONTRIBUTING.md. Bench should output p50/p95, tokens, and a permalink.
nora (Content): I'll write a concise blog (500-700w) that doubles as a README summary. CTA: GH star + open issue template for results. Two email subject variants for A/B test.
felix (Design): I'll prepare OG image, two hero variants for A/B, and a 6s terminal GIF. Avoid heavy branding so community can fork.
lucy (Growth): timeline suggestion: draft by 05/04, assets 05/08, GH + blog 05/12, HN + Discord seed 05/13, community office hours 05/18.
omar (DevRel): include UTMs: `?utm_source=oss-starter&utm_campaign=kit-launch`. Also add a small `bench/expected.json` so people can sanity check.
nora (Content): messaging A/B: A) "Start local LLM dev in 10m" B) "Forkable OSS starter for LLMs + reproducible bench". Small seed list for test.
felix (Design): uploading frames to Figma 05/06. Will attach GIF to README and blog.
lucy (Growth): inbound routing: blog CTA -> GH issues template -> HubSpot form -> GTM -> slack #sales-inbound webhook. ops: need GTM container + webhook docs.
ops-bot: INC-7007 created: provision GTM container and slack webhook config. ETA 6h.
omar (DevRel): need short GPU window to produce canonical numbers (1xA100 for 24h). ops-bot?
ops-bot: INC-7008 created: 1xA100 for 24h reserved, ETA 10h.
community-bot: Note: when live, auto-post to #community-updates, tag @contributors and include `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
nora (Content): I'll include a short "how to contribute results" section: run `./run-bench.sh --output results.json` then open a PR with results.
lucy (Growth): growth checklist: blog, GH release, HN post, Discord event, email seed, office hours. Owners: content=nora, devrel=omar, design=felix, growth=lucy.
omar (DevRel): quick note for README: show exact commands e.g. ``./run-bench.sh --scenario=docker --warmup=1`` and sample expected output snippet.
felix (Design): hero A/B ready for test.
lucy (Growth): Any blockers?
omar (DevRel): waiting on infra token for quantized-cpu test. ops-bot?
ops-bot: INC-7009 created: quantized-cpu slot scheduled, ETA 8h.
lucy (Growth): Great. I'll schedule a 20m launch sync (05/09). Keep copy short and make bench reproducible. :seedling:
